# RecursiveCteNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.RecursiveCteNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Implements recursive CTE execution. Evaluates the anchor query first, then iteratively executes the recursive query using the previous iteration&#x27;s results until no new rows are produced or the maximum recursion depth is reached.

```text

```

Initializes a new instance of the PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.RecursiveCteNode class.

- Parameter `cteName`: The CTE name.
- Parameter `anchorNode`: The anchor query plan node (non-recursive part).
- Parameter `recursiveNodeFactory`: Factory that creates the recursive plan node for each iteration. Receives the previous iteration&#x27;s rows and returns a node that produces new rows.
- Parameter `maxRecursion`: Maximum recursion depth. Default is 100 (matching SQL Server). Set to 0 for unlimited recursion (matching SQL Server&#x27;s OPTION(MAXRECURSION 0)).
